text: A股三大指数今日集体上涨，截至收盘，上证指数涨0.24%，深证成指涨0.59%，创业板指涨0.64%，北证50跌0.06%，科创50指数跌0.87%。全市场成交额20939亿元，较上日缩量4361亿元，全市场超4000只个股上涨。板块题材上，生物制品、生物疫苗、贵金属、创新药、CRO概念涨幅居前；厨卫电器、国家大基金持股、电子化学品、小金属、煤炭开采加工板块跌幅居前。盘面上，创新药板块高开高走掀涨停潮，三元基因、石药创新、沃森生物、智飞生物、昂立康、康泰生物等20余股涨停，新开源、华兰股份、圣湘生物、泽璟制药等多股涨超10%。贵金属板块表现强势，兴业银锡
text_en: China's three major A-share indices rose collectively today. By the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.24%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.59%, ChiNext rose 0.64%, BeiBei 50 fell 0.06%, and STAR 50 fell 0.87%. Total market turnover was RMB 2.0939 trillion, down RMB 436.1 billion from the previous day, with over 4,000 stocks rising. By sector, biological products, biological vaccines, precious metals, innovative drugs and CRO concepts led gains; kitchen and bath appliances, National Big Fund holdings, electronic chemicals, minor metals and coal mining and processing led losses. In trading, innovative drug stocks opened higher and rallied to a wave of limit-ups, with over 20 stocks including Sanyuan Gene, CSPC Innovation, Walvax Biotechnology, Zhifei Biological, Anglikang and Kangtai Biological hitting the daily limit, and XinKaiYuan, Hualan Biological Engineering, Sansure Biotech and Zelgen Pharmaceuticals rising over 10%.
